param.label: Assembly
param.help: One FASTA or GFA1 dataset, plain or gzip-compressed. Individual marker modes require one sequence; All and Bulk accept multiple records in that dataset. FASTA does not show whether a sequence is circular: use only confirmed circular sequences for reorientation.

param.label: Circular sequence
param.help: One FASTA dataset, plain or gzip-compressed. FASTA does not show whether a sequence is circular: use only a confirmed circular sequence for reorientation.

param.label: If no marker-based reorientation succeeds
param.help: The fallback requires enough coding sequences; none keeps DNAapler's default behavior.

param.label: Random seed
param.help: Leave blank to use DNAapler's default (13). Used by random coding-sequence methods.
